sources.title: BLIP3-o: A Family of Fully Open Unified Multimodal Models—Architecture ...
sources.snippet: Building on our innovative model design, training recipe, and datasets, we develop BLIP3-o, a suite of state-of-the-art unified multimodal models. BLIP3-o achieves superior performance across most of the popular benchmarks spanning both image understanding and generation tasks.

sources.title: Understanding BLIP : A Huggingface Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) is a multimodal AI model that combines computer vision and natural language processing to understand both images and text together. It is trained on large-scale image-text pairs, enabling strong performance in vision-language tasks.
